notes.title: Kaizo Block Achievement Update
notes.content:
This is (hopefully) the final Kaizo Block update. Here is a list of the changes made:

[list]
[*]Steam achievement integration
[*]New secrets to find
[*]Numerous bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Kaizo Block: Major Content Update
notes.content:
Major content was added and changed in this update. Below is a list of the most important changes:

[list]
[*] 8 new bonus levels, taking the form of time-based survival challenges
[*] An entirely new (and amazing) soundtrack created by the talented FoxuPai
[*] A new and much improved tutorial
[*] Improved controller support (note: if Steam Input is enabled it may lead to issues with native controls)
[*] Improved menus and UI
[/list]

notes.title: A Long Overdue Update
notes.content:
All known bugs fixed, including:
[list]
[*]Issues with music and sound volume
[*]Issues with the slide sound effect
[*]Issues with inputs in the tutorial
[*]The pause menu appearing in the wrong place if opened while respawning
[*]Saw pop in during level 7
[/list]
